# Billsby

Billsby is a subscription billing platform for managing customers, subscriptions, invoices, products, plans, usage counters, add-ons, and allowances.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/billsby/.

## Actions

- **Create Customer**: Create a Billsby customer without a subscription or payment card.
- **Get Customer** (read-only): Get billing, contact, payment-status, and account details for one Billsby customer.
- **Get Subscription** (read-only): Get billing schedule, customer, product, plan, pricing, status, and revenue details for one Billsby subscription.
- **Get Subscription Shipping Address** (read-only): Get the shipping address associated with one Billsby subscription.
- **List Customer Subscriptions** (read-only): List all subscriptions belonging to one Billsby customer.
- **List Customers** (read-only): Return one page of customers for the connected Billsby company, optionally filtered by a partial customer name.
- **List Product Plans** (read-only): List the plans and billing cycles configured for one Billsby product.
- **List Products** (read-only): Return one page of Billsby products, optionally filtered by name or visibility.
- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): Return one page of company subscriptions with optional status, trial, product, plan, and ordering filters.
- **Update Customer**: Replace the editable contact and billing-address details for an existing Billsby customer.
